 From royal drama and celebrity romance to baseball, historical action and the music industry, upcoming K-dramas OTT releases for November and December 2026 offer a varied lineup.  As the winter months loom, the idea of snuggling into an oversized couch before a TV with a plush throw blanket to watch your favourite K-dramas is enchanting. And the best part is that the final two months of 2026 are bringing Korean dramas that move well beyond familiar romance plots, with royal betrayals, complicated relationships, historical conflicts, baseball and the entertainment industry’s pursuit of fame. We list here 5 upcoming K-drama OTT releases in November and December 2026 including the Remarried Empress, One of a Kind Romance, Gift, Sacred Jewel and Tantara. Their premieres are scheduled across Netflix, Disney+, TVING, tvN, and JTBC. Here are the release dates, cast members, storylines and streaming details for these K-dramas.
 5 Upcoming K-Drama OTT Releases For November And December 2026
 The Remarried Empress (Disney+): November 4
 Disney+ premieres this fantasy romance on November 4. Empress Navier’s marriage ends when Emperor Sovieshu asks for a divorce after falling for another woman. She answers by setting a condition and considering a marriage to Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom, a move that could shift the balance between rival kingdoms. Based on the popular web novel and webtoon, the series stars Shin Min-a, Ju Ji-hoon, Lee Jong-suk and Lee Se-young. 
 One of a Kind Romance (TVING): November 9
 TVING releases this 12-episode romantic comedy on November 9. Adapted from a webtoon of the same name, it follows job seeker Gong Yu-il, who becomes the manager of top star Tak Mu-i, a celebrity dealing with anxiety and insomnia caused by persistent stalking. Their working arrangement slowly turns personal. Park Soo-young (Joy of Red Velvet) and Kim Hyun-jin lead the cast, with Shin Hyun-soo and Kang Na-eon also appearing. 
 Gift (tvN): December 5
 This tvN sports drama arrives on December 5. After an accident, a former professional pitching coach gains the ability to recognise baseball talent at a glance. Kim Woo-bin plays Jung Min-yong, who takes charge of a struggling high school team and clashes with team leader Yoon Seo-jin (Seo Eun-soo), who cares more about the players’ development than about winning.
 Sacred Jewel (Prime Video): December 2026
 JTBC’s historical action drama is expected in December 2026, with the exact date still to be confirmed. Set in 1258, during the conflict between Goryeo and the Mongol Empire, it follows royal guard commander Baek-gyeol (Ahn Bo-hyun), who joins a mission to recover a sacred relic believed to hold miraculous powers. Claudia Kim plays Princess Wang-hee, and Lee Sung-min and Ha Yoon-kyung also star.
 Tantara (Netflix): December 11
 Netflix has confirmed December 11 for this period drama set between the 1960s and 1980s. Min-ja (Song Hye-kyo) grew up in poverty and enters the music business alongside her childhood friend Dong-gu (Gong Yoo). Along the way they meet Min-hui, an aspiring singer with a striking voice, and Seok Gil-yeo, a hitmaker who can turn newcomers into stars. The series is written by Noh Hee-gyoung (Our Blues) and directed by Lee Yoon-jung (Coffee Prince), with Kim Seol-hyun and Cha Seung-won also in the cast.
